tools.purpose: List client-side entitlement decisions in a DEX or APK next to the strings that show whether a server authority is reachable.
tools.expect: candidate gate table, authority-surface table, and an optional patch-table skeleton

notes: Read-only. --query narrows the entitlement words; the default set covers licence, vip, premium, subscription, purchase, entitlement, unlock, trial, activation, card key, redeem, quota, upgrade.
